styles.name: Rotate
styles.description: Upload a character or object and generate the other 8 directional views from that single image.
styles.example_prompt: A knight in silver armor holding a shield

A.prompt: ONE COMPACT STATIONARY SUMMON CAST. Start grounded and still. Both hands on the low greatsword; draw the sword close into a quiet low vertical guard without swinging. Keeping one gauntlet securing the low weapon, release the other hand and lift it just to chest height, open palm facing upward in a small precise calling gesture. Slight chest expansion and visor tilt upward. Brief firm ritual hold, then lower the casting hand back to the handle and recover. Compact, clean, restrained gesture, no overhead motion. The shoulder and elbow clearly articulate the upward summon, not just idle breathing. Animate the SAME front-facing Ash Warden in this exact starting image. Fixed South top-down view, transparent isolated character, full silhouette and sword always inside 192x192 canvas. Preserve original charcoal plate armor, orange magma cracks, visor helmet, dry branches, ash tabard and single broad greatsword. Feet remain planted at the original location. No walking, stepping, charge, sword swing or melee. No meteor, projectile, fireball, particles, aura, glow cloud, magic circle or scenery in character frames. Return smoothly to the supplied low sword idle stance.

B.prompt: ONE STRONG STATIONARY SUMMON CAST. Start firmly grounded. Lower the broad greatsword to rest beside the body with ONE hand supporting its hilt. Free the other gauntlet and drive a large deliberate summoning gesture from waist up to an OPEN HAND ABOVE THE SHOULDER, palm toward the sky. The upper torso arches upward, helmet tilts toward the heavens, both shoulder plates and elbow participate. Hold that commanding high calling pose, then lower the arm and return both hands to original low sword stance. Clearly larger gesture than a small chest-height prayer. Feet never move. The sword stays low and passive, no raised sword or attack arc. Animate the SAME front-facing Ash Warden in this exact starting image. Fixed South top-down view, transparent isolated character, full silhouette and sword always inside 192x192 canvas. Preserve original charcoal plate armor, orange magma cracks, visor helmet, dry branches, ash tabard and single broad greatsword. Feet remain planted at the original location. No walking, stepping, charge, sword swing or melee. No meteor, projectile, fireball, particles, aura, glow cloud, magic circle or scenery in character frames. Return smoothly to the supplied low sword idle stance.
